title: Scene-Consistent Illumination Transfer for Inserted Advertising Graphics
abstract: arXiv:2609.37951v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Replacing a visible advertisement in a broadcast frame is geometrically straightforward but photometrically delicate. A pasted graphic can have the correct perspective and still appear detached when its brightness, shading, or shadow disagrees with the surface beneath it. This paper presents Ad-Relight, an inference-only procedure for transferring scene illumination to a supplied advertising graphic without collecting a banner-specific training set. The procedure first separates slowly varying shade from graphic structure, then probes a pretrained diffusion relighter with two nearly identical backgrounds to isolate the contribution of the target region. A final pass combines this residual with a smoothed luminance field and a soft attenuation mask. Across 560 generated placements, the approach improves structural similarity, perceptual distance, and illumination agreement over geometric compositing and direct relighting baselines. Human

translated_title: 面向插入广告图形的场景一致光照迁移
translated_abstract: 在广播画面中替换可见广告在几何上很简单，但在光度上却十分微妙。粘贴上去的图形即使具有正确的透视，当其亮度、明暗或阴影与下方表面不一致时，仍会显得格格不入。本文提出了 Ad-Relight，一种仅需推理的方法，用于将场景光照迁移到所提供的广告图形上，而无需收集针对横幅广告的专门训练集。该方法首先将缓慢变化的阴影与图形结构分离，然后利用两个几乎相同的背景对预训练的扩散重光照模型进行探测，以隔离目标区域的贡献。最后一步将该残差与平滑的亮度场和软衰减掩膜相融合。在 560 个生成的广告放置样本上，该方法在结构相似性、感知距离和光照一致性方面均优于几何合成和直接重光照等基线方法。人类评估（原文截断）……
tldr: 本文提出 Ad-Relight，一种无需专门训练集的纯推理方法，通过分离阴影与图形结构、探测预训练扩散重光照模型并融合亮度场，将广播场景的光照一致地迁移到插入的广告图形上。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Ad-Relight, an inference-only method that transfers scene-consistent illumination onto inserted advertising graphics by separating shading from structure, probing a pretrained diffusion relighter, and blending the residual with a smoothed luminance field, without requiring any banner-specific training data.
